q1_issues.issue: (Start sk_sell_1 sk_launch_1) puts an event witness in Start's value slot, which the Time section defines over structured calendar/clock terms; an event-denoting boundary is the Before/BeforeBy ordering relation between the two witnesses.

q2_gaps: "by V-ing" as a means/method adjunct -- Instrument is restricted to a tool or substance and no other named role fits, so the parse fell back on the preposition-named oblique (By <event> <event>) with a reified gerund
"since <event-denoting NP>" as an interval boundary -- Start/End are specified only over calendar/clock terms, leaving no interval form for an event boundary

internal bracketing of a three-noun compound ("record industry expectations": record-industry vs record expectations) -- the compound-kind rule is stated for a two-word modifier_noun and gives no bracketing procedure, and this is a genuine ambiguity
notes: "more than 1 million" -> (CardinalityAtLeast sk_songs_1 1000001), the of-phrase on the nominalization "launch" -> (Of sk_launch_1 sk_store_1), the projection of the definite launch and store typings out of the seal, and "a week ago" -> Past + (BeforeBy ... now 1 week) are all handled per the instruction set. (Ongoing sk_sell_1) sits between two rules -- a gerund is not one of the four licensed Ongoing markers, but the "since X" interval bullet says Start usually comes with Ongoing.
